node.title: EF Galois-stabilizer descent
node.statement: For the B-defined extension-fiber alignment incidence over an admissible row B<=E, every horizontal irreducible component is classified by its stabilizer under Gal(E/B): full stabilizer gives base descent; a proper nontrivial stabilizer gives an intermediate-subfield pullback/tower component; only trivial stabilizer/full Galois orbit remains as the genuinely full-field case.
node.attack_surface: standard Galois descent for irreducible components of a B-defined projective incidence
node.falsifier: a component with nontrivial stabilizer that is neither descended to the fixed field nor part of the corresponding tower case
